  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [P] Session persistence and reopening

Cover revision-guarded mapping replacement, hunk resolution/pagination, coherent treemap reads and DiffTreePanel navigation; this develops proposal review, not another acceptance lifecycle.

Explain rendering-only correspondence, modification pairs, removals, fold filtering, before-side provenance and coordinate maps. Distinguish projectSelectedDiagramRows composition and whole-diagram diff alternatives from optional revision review and ChangeSession acceptance; this is shared presentation detail.

  `-- [3] DiffSession generation workflow  new canvas
      |-- DiffSessionWorkflowService ownership and boundaries
      |   `-- Introduce the distinct capture/analyze/materialize/validate lifecycle and its ChangeSessionService, DiffSessionTools, DiffSessionRuntime and DiffSessionRunStore dependencies. Completion produces a ready proposal, never acceptance; this warrants its own overview instead of broadening proposal history or presentation canvases.
      |-- Frozen evidence and staged tools
      |   `-- Attach from the overview's capture and DiffSessionTools components. Explain pinned repository/commits/head/comparisonBase, reuse of original session baselines, immutable hunks and pinned source reads. Analysis is read-only; materialization targets the run's proposal; completion checks captured-hunk coverage.
      |-- Runs, artifacts and interruption
      |   `-- Attach from the overview's run/store components. Explain request deduplication, the shared agent conversation, stages, context/prompts/transcript/performance artifacts, cancellation, failure and interrupted-run reporting. Keep run persistence distinct from proposal receipts and undo history.
      |-- Workflow entry points
      |   `-- Attach from the overview's start component. Show DiffSessionWorkflowPanel and PushIntegrationService callers, push-event deduplication, skip rules, net-comparison context and status tracking. This explains workflow initiation without expanding into unrelated push transport infrastructure.
